rca_of_the_issue: BlogCreatePage crash: The component uses ReactQuill (react-quill-new) for rich text editing. The error occurs during component render. Possible causes: 1) ReactQuill SSR issue, 2) Missing quill CSS, 3) Auth state race condition. The error message 'An error occurred in the <BlogCreatePage> component' suggests a runtime error during render.
